title: listing-smoke-test-protocol-and-short-copy-lab
summary: Quick, pragmatic protocol to validate partner tiles + short copy variants before full listing submission. Combines a smoke-test checklist, lightweight A/B hypotheses, and an asset preflight so partner launches avoid common rejection loops.
body:
Purpose:
- Create a fast pre-submission runbook for partner listing content (tile + 1-paragraph description + 3 benefit bullets + CTA).
- Surface obvious issues that cause listing rejections or conversion regressions: missing assets, non-compliant claims, localization gaps, telemetry gaps.

Intended audience:
- PMs and partner managers preparing a marketplace tile
- Copywriters and growth marketers running conversion experiments
- Solutions engineers prepping technical screenshots and demo flows

When to use:
- Use this lab when a partner has initial assets and copy and wants a fast internal QA before submitting to marketplace intake. Should take ~45-75 minutes.

Protocol overview (steps):
1) Content sanity pass (10-15m)
   - Verify tile title length <= 48 chars, no brand-overuse, product name first if partner requires.
   - 1-line subtitle (optional) max 80 chars. If long, create alt short subtitle.
   - Description: 1 short paragraph (<= 280 chars) and a longer 2-3 line supporting paragraph (<= 700 chars).
   - Look for forbidden claims: "HIPAA certified", "guaranteed accuracy", dollar savings claims without evidence. Flag for legal.

2) Benefit bullets and CTA (10m)
   - 3 benefit bullets: start each with a verb, include one technical capability (e.g., "Runs on VPC + Private Deployments"), one business outcome, one integration benefit.
   - CTA variants: "Get started free", "Schedule demo", "Request trial (enterprise only)". Map allowed CTAs to partner plan (self-serve vs sales-assisted).

3) Asset preflight (10-15m)
   - Logo: SVG + PNG 512px, transparent background, safe spacing.
   - Screenshot: annotated screenshot + raw screenshot; include redacted PII.
   - Video: optional 30-60s mp4, subtitles .srt, hosted link (S3 or Vimeo private).
   - One sample prompt or demo script for AI features (max 120 words).

4) Compliance & privacy flags (5-10m)
   - Does the listing claim handling of regulated data? (PHI, financial PII). If yes, tag for security review and Private deployment compatibility note.
   - Data residency claims need explicit region mapping.

5) Localization quick checks (5-10m)
   - EN-US base required. If target markets include EU or APAC, provide localized title + 1-paragraph FR/DE/JA drafts. If not available, mark "en-only" and set expectations.
   - Currency/time formatting should use neutral examples (avoid $ if global).

6) Telemetry hooks & conversion instrumentation (5-10m)
   - Ensure partner provides: click target for CTA, landing-page url with tracking params, UTM channel mapping.
   - Add telemetry checklist entry: impressions, clicks, click-to-CTA, signup-success page event. Owner: partner PM or solutions engineer.

7) Lightweight smoke acceptance (5m)
   - Does content fit listing UI without truncation? (Run mock tile in console preview).
   - Do all links resolve and are they not blocked by corporate firewalls?
   - Asset file sizes under limits: logos <200KB, screenshots <1.5MB, video <30MB for preview upload.

Copy variants lab (quick sketches):
- Variant A (concise, product-focused):
  Title: "QuickInference: Hosted LLM inference",
  Subtitle: "Low-latency, pay-as-you-go API for production apps",
  Short description: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower token costs. Redwood-backed runtime + open-model catalog for text gen, embeddings, and chat.",
  Bullets: ["Fast: sub-200ms for typical prompts","Cost controls: smart batching + KV cache","Enterprise-ready: private VPC & audit logs"],
  CTA: "Get started free",

- Variant B (outcome-first, customer benefit):
  Title: "Ship LLM features — predictable latency & costs",
  Subtitle: "Reduce per-call cost without sacrificing quality",
  Short description: "Cut inference costs with batching, caching, and quantization advice while keeping output quality under continuous evals. Works hosted or on-prem.",
  Bullets: ["Save on token spend with smart batching","Rollouts & fallbacks to keep apps online","Pin model versions for stable behavior"],
  CTA: "Request trial",

- Variant C (verticalized quick-fragment — e.g., search):
  Title: "Legal search accelerator for LLMs",
  Subtitle: "Embeddings + reranking tuned for compliance-heavy search",
  Short description: "Pre-built embedding models, rerank pipelines, and audit trails for secure document search in regulated environments.",
  Bullets: ["PII redaction baked into ingest","SLA-backed query latency","Private deployment available"],
  CTA: "Schedule demo",

Notes: these are sketches. Replace product names and claims with partner-specific facts in final copy. Keep one variant strictly structural for AB tests (A = product, B = outcome, C = vertical).

A/B hypotheses to run after publish (initial 2 weeks):
- H1: Outcome-first (Variant B) increases click-through by +12% vs product-focused (A) for mid-market buyers.
- H2: Verticalized tile (C) increases demo requests by +18% in targeted partner cohorts vs general tile.
- H3: Replacing "Get started free" with "Request trial" reduces self-serve signups but increases MQL quality.

Acceptance checklist (final gate):
- [ ] Title <=48 chars and no unreviewed superlatives.
- [ ] Description has evidence links for any quant claims.
- [ ] Legal sign-off for regulated claims.
- [ ] Asset bundle complete (logo, 2 screenshots, optional video).
- [ ] Landing page instrumented with required telemetry events.
- [ ] Localization tag set (en-only or languages present).
- [ ] CTA mapped to partner plan and routing configured.
- [ ] Partner contact and escalation path added to listing metadata.

Common gotchas (notes to self):
- Partners sometimes upload full-resolution screenshots with PII — always ask for redacted + annotated versions.
- Partners claim "enterprise-grade" without certifications — flag for legal.
- Video hosted behind auth breaks marketplace preview; request public preview token or private Vimeo link.
- Titles with emojis often get stripped; don't rely on emoji to convey meaning.

Open questions (to resolve in intake):
- Does partner need a special CTA for Dedicated customers (e.g., contact sales vs provisioning)?
- Are there model-architecture claims (like "GPT-5") that need to be normalized to our model catalog names?

Quick checklist for intake form fields (to copy into intake ticket):
- Listing title, subtitle, 280-char short desc, long desc, 3 bullets, CTA label, CTA URL, logo(s), screenshot(s) annotated, video link, sample prompt/demo, telemetry endpoint, landing UTM params, localization flags, legal contact, partner owner, partner SLA tier.

Appendix: sample copy comments for partner edits (sticky notes)
- "Swap 'guaranteed' -> 'aims to' or 'designed to'"
- "Change 'HIPAA-ready' to 'supports private deployment for regulated data' until legal clears"
- "If partner wants both 'demo' and 'trial' CTAs, default live tile to demo and add trial link on landing page"

Quick reminders for partner PM handoff:
- Deliver assets in a single zip with README.txt mapping each file name to field in intake form.
- Provide one subject matter contact who can approve small copy edits within 48 hours.

Last edited notes:
- 2025-02-12: added telemetry checklist and simplified asset size limits after SRE feedback (Hannah).
- 2024-11-12: initial draft created during partner intake sync with Jared and Lena.

Unresolved: legal wording for cross-border data residency claims — flagging product-legal.

Tags for internal search: smoke-lab, listing-preflight, short-copy, conversion-hypotheses
